instruction: Create an <h1> heading that says: "Hello World!"

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: You've created your first HTML element! The <h1> tag creates the largest heading. Great job!

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Remember: Use <h1> to open the heading, write "Hello World!", then close with </h1>. Make sure your code looks like: <h1>Hello World!</h1>
